slides.title: You're Over-Tooled and Under-Skilled
slides.subtitle: Master one tool. Then move on.

bullets: Pick one tool and go deep - not ten tools and stay shallow
Free tools land interviews. Paid stacks don't.
Employers want fluency, not a long list of names

caption: Hot take - most cyber candidates have too many tools open and not enough depth in any of them. One tool mastered beats ten half-learned every time. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #infosec #cypherjobs #careertips
